macros.name: mlhref
macros.doc: A multi-line version of the hyperref command, \href.

macros.name: mlhyperlink
macros.doc: A multi-line version of the \hyperlink command.

macros.name: mlhyperref
macros.doc: A multi-line version of the \hyperref command.

macros.name: mlMarksOn
macros.doc: By expanding \mlMarksOn, you turn on the marking of the links.

macros.name: mlnameref
macros.doc: A multi-line version of the \nameref command.

macros.name: OldStyleBoxesOn
macros.doc: You can declare \OldStyleBoxesOn in the preamble to revert to the old style that does not use the information written to the auxiliary file.

macros.name: turnSyllbCntOn
macros.doc: You can display the syllable numbers of multi-line hypertext by expanding \turnSyllbCntOn; \turnSyllbCntOff turns off this feature again.
